result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in Australia, my recommendation would be **Xero**\. It's probably the best all-round accounting software for most Australian small businesses in 2026.

However, the best choice depends on whether you're a sole trader, have employees, send lots of invoices, or manage stock.

## My top 5 accounting software choices

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

- Easy to use and excellent bank reconciliation.
- GST, BAS and payroll capabilities.
- Excellent accountant and bookkeeper integration.
- Good for businesses that want to grow.
  
  Australian plans start around A\$37/month.
  
  [Visit Xero](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for payroll and employees)

- Strong Australian tax and payroll features.
- Good for businesses with employees.
- Useful inventory and job management options.
  
  Business plans start around A\$35/month.
  
  [Visit MYOB](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EgpRGTuKXM9JBQhBxDeBmotPOK2V1CAxW6csrlBGPGPM15pztH3eOcpEVWcqc6mS0O1OJQxiy3rYDKVoibK-tXZzwx_-fnc0UCKsZf5bUQtlgBDTtK7dsXwaLO2yAIKNfloGWbyBHt0g2gG5iJtWLQko_1xFOodwaVRw5Zh1K1GZ7uleuWwINKnPwp3V07V7?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. QuickBooks**

- Good invoicing and expense tracking.
- Useful financial reporting.
- Suitable for smaller service businesses.
  
  Australian plans and features vary.
  
  [Visit QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Reckon One**

- Good budget-friendly option.
- GST and bookkeeping features.
- Worth considering for smaller businesses.
  
  [Visit Reckon](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

- Good value for money.
- Automation and invoicing.
- Integrates with other Zoho business applications.
  
  [Visit Zoho Books](https://www.zoho.com/au/books/)

These choices reflect current Australian comparisons of accounting features, payroll, GST and BAS support. ## What I'd look for in accounting software

For an Australian small business, I'd prioritise\:

- Automatic bank feeds and reconciliation.
- GST tracking and BAS preparation/lodgement.
- Professional invoicing and quotes.
- Expense tracking and receipt scanning.
- Payroll and superannuation if you employ staff.
- Easy access for your accountant or bookkeeper.
